correctness.rationale: For odd characteristic the nondegenerate trace pairing and the rank-one selfadjoint parametrization are explicit. Scalar character orthogonality yields the exact all-frequency formula. Restriction of ten quadrics to a (2,2) system has one-dimensional Q kernel. For any elliptic curve with two Fq-points, pencils |2O| and |O+P| give disjoint deck-involution ramification and an embedding in P1xP1, realizing every eligible trace. Hasse excludes point-free smooth sections; Waterhouse guarantees trace -1. Fixed exact examples over F3,F5,F7, checked for q+2 points and squarefree discriminants, corroborate the zero coefficient.
